outcomeNote: A single cited baraita, adduced for its parallel to the preceding one about the Medes.

segments.he: תַּנְיָא אָמַר רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל: בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה דְבָרִים אוֹהֵב אֲנִי אֶת הַפַּרְסִיִּים: הֵן צְנוּעִין בַּאֲכִילָתָן, וּצְנוּעִין בְּבֵית הַכִּסֵּא, וּצְנוּעִין בְּדָבָר אַחֵר.
segments.en: «It was taught» in a baraita, «Rabban Gamliel said: In three aspects» of their conduct, «I like the Persians:» They are a modest people; «they are modest in their eating, they are modest in the lavatory, and they are modest in another matter,» i.e., sexual relations.

moves.summary: adduces a formally parallel baraita in which Rabban Gamliel praises three Persian customs
moves.about: adduces a baraita of Rabban Gamliel praising three modest Persian practices, parallel in form to R' Akiva's praise of the Medes
